experiment_data.hypothesis: Confidence-aware adaptive sampling budget allocation (fewer samples for high-confidence instances, full N=8 for low-confidence) can recover nearly all SC F1 gains while saving 40-50% of inference cost, because high-confidence instances already have low diversity and gain nothing from additional samples.

fewnerd.note: Greedy > U8; adaptive h1/l8 best: greedy for high-conf, N=8 SC for low-conf

scierc.note: U8 > Greedy; top67% h2/l8 saves 50% with negligible loss
